subject.title: fix(xai): apply request policy to video generation requests

question: Should xAI video polling and generated-media download always use default-deny SSRF protection, requiring explicit `request.allowPrivateNetwork: true` for private targets even if some existing setups relied on the previous unguarded behavior?
rationale: The code and tests establish the behavior, but only an owner can accept the intentional compatibility tradeoff at this provider security boundary.

options.title: Approve Default-Deny
options.body: Accept the explicit private-network opt-in as the permanent xAI video contract and merge after exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Preserve Legacy Reachability
options.body: Revise the patch to retain a compatibility path, with a clearly documented shipped contract and focused tests proving when the weaker path applies.

options.title: Pause The Change
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it if no owner is willing to accept either the upgrade break or a documented compatibility exception.

recommendation.title: Approve Default-Deny
recommendation.body: Accept the explicit private-network opt-in as the permanent xAI video contract and merge after exact-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Among the available routing signals, this person is the strongest candidate for the shared provider HTTP and SSRF-boundary decision.
